title: Provider Definition
description: Schema for an individual LLM provider definition. Validated against the WireAdapter registry at boot time.

name.description: Unique provider identifier (e.g., 'anthropic', 'deepseek'). Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens.

wire.description: Wire protocol type. Must match a registered WireAdapter name (validated dynamically at boot).

baseUrl.description: Upstream API base URL. Must be an HTTPS URL.

displayName.description: Human-readable provider name for UI display (e.g., 'Anthropic').

keyEnv.description: Environment variable name holding the API key (e.g., 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'). Null means no key required.

mode.description: Authentication mode: 'env' (environment variable), 'oauth' (OAuth2 flow), 'static' (hardcoded — not recommended).

headerName.description: Custom auth header name. Defaults to wire-specific standard.

headerPrefix.description: Prefix before the key value in the auth header (e.g., 'Bearer ').

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to include in upstream requests. Deep-merged across sources.

features.description: Capability flags describing what this provider supports. Deep-merged across sources.

supportsStreaming.description: Whether the provider supports SSE streaming responses.

supportsToolUse.description: Whether the provider supports function/tool calling.

supportsVision.description: Whether the provider supports image inputs.

supportsCaching.description: Whether the provider supports prompt caching with reduced pricing.

supportsThinking.description: Whether the provider supports extended thinking/reasoning.

supportsJsonMode.description: Whether the provider supports structured JSON output mode.
